q: The first and most fundamental Pillar of Islam declaring faith in Allah and His Messenger is the ____. (P1)
explain: The Shahadah: 'La ilaha illa Allah, Muhammadur Rasulullah.'

q: Muslims worship the One Almighty God whose Arabic name is ____. (P1)
explain: Allah is the Unique, Absolute Creator of the universe with no partners.

q: The holy book revealed by Allah to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the Holy ____. (P1)
explain: The Qur'an is the final, uncorrupted revelation for mankind.

q: Muslims perform obligatory daily prayers (Salat) ____ times each day. (P1)
explain: The five daily prayers: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.

q: Prophetic history (P1): Who was Prophet Adam (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the first human being and first prophet created by Allah
explain: Prophet Adam (AS) was the first human being and first prophet created by Allah.

q: Prophetic history (P1): Who was Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the Patriarch known as Khalilullah (Friend of Allah) who built the Ka'bah
explain: Prophet Ibrahim (AS) was the Patriarch known as Khalilullah (Friend of Allah) who built the Ka'bah.

q: Prophetic history (P1): Who was Prophet Musa (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet who spoke with Allah (Kalimullah) and received the Tawrat
explain: Prophet Musa (AS) was the prophet who spoke with Allah (Kalimullah) and received the Tawrat.

q: Prophetic history (P1): Who was Prophet Isa (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the noble prophet born miraculously to Maryam who received the Injil
explain: Prophet Isa (AS) was the noble prophet born miraculously to Maryam who received the Injil.

q: Prophetic history (P1): Who was Prophet Nuh (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet who built the Ark to save believers from the great deluge
explain: Prophet Nuh (AS) was the prophet who built the Ark to save believers from the great deluge.

q: Prophetic history (P1): Who was Prophet Dawud (AS) in Islamic heritage?
options: the prophet-king who received the holy Psalms (Zabur)
explain: Prophet Dawud (AS) was the prophet-king who received the holy Psalms (Zabur).
